name: tri-control-hub
description: TRI-CONTROL HUB - 3-in-1 Smart RC Car IT Fest Project

scripts.dev: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),m={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css; charset=utf-8','.js':'application/javascript; charset=utf-8','.json':'application/json','.svg':'image/svg+xml','.png':'image/png'};http.createServer((q,s)=>{let u=(q.url||'/').split('?')[0];if(u==='/')u='/index.html';const p=path.normalize(path.join(process.cwd(),'website',u));if(!p.startsWith(path.join(process.cwd(),'website'))||!fs.existsSync(p)||!fs.statSync(p).isFile()){s.writeHead(404);return s.end('Not found');}s.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':m[path.extname(p)]||'application/octet-stream','Cache-Control':'no-cache'});fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(s);}).listen(3000,'0.0.0.0',()=>console.log('TRI-CONTROL HUB serving ./website on port 3000'));"
